image_location_description: Bottom of the image: the two chunky white feet and short lower legs with tan/dark-tan hints.

steps.title: Start lower legs
steps.description: Add 4x white 1x2 bricks on rear 2 studs of the feet (2 per leg).

steps.title: Build leg height
steps.description: Stack 4x white 1x2 bricks directly on the previous layer.

steps.title: Cap the legs
steps.description: Add 2x white 1x2 plates on top, one per leg, to lock the stack.

steps.title: Add tan print hints
steps.description: Attach 1x tan + 1x dark-tan 1x1 round plates to front of legs.
